quotes.name: Dank Abara
quotes.quote: I’ve heard San Antonio has more incidents than other neighborhoods, and Lake Merritt’s response times are slow, but I don’t know the specifics. It’s just something people talk about around here.

quotes.name: Delia Vargas-Ruiz
quotes.quote: Working at the transit hub, I hear people talk about the response times, but honestly, most folks around here just keep their heads down and go about their day. The numbers are what they are.

quotes.name: Melton Neilon
quotes.quote: I’ve heard San Antonio’s been hit hard lately, and Lake Merritt’s taking longer to get help—it’s worrying, but I trust folks are doing what they can with what they’ve got.

claim: I’ve heard San Antonio has more incidents than other neighborhoods, and Lake Merritt’s response times are slow, but I don’t know the specifics. It’s just something people talk about around here.
